headline: A passed ball in the 10th beats the Expos
recap: The Phillies beat Montreal 2-1 in ten innings at Veterans Stadium. Luis Aguayo opened the bottom of the 10th with a single, moved to second and third on two sacrifice bunts, and scored on a passed ball by Expos catcher Dann Bilardello for the winning run. Dan Schatzeder, who worked the 10th, got the win.

Bruce Ruffin and Montreal's Bob Sebra matched up for the first nine innings. Ruffin went all nine, allowing eight hits and three walks with three strikeouts, and the one run against him was unearned after a throwing error by shortstop Steve Jeltz in the second. Sebra went seven innings and struck out nine. The Phillies tied it 1-1 in the seventh on a Greg Gross sacrifice fly that scored Ron Roenicke.
George Wright had three hits for the Expos, and Wright's triple in the top of the 10th was stranded when Schatzeder struck out Al Newman. Montreal left ten men on base.
